<?php
// E2E probe (test only): lets the test see the stored gateway settings, pretend the store address is HTTPS for one page view,
// and put a real file where the verification file would be.
add_action( 'init', function () {
	if ( isset( $_GET['cz_https'] ) ) {
		add_filter( 'home_url', function ( $u ) { return preg_replace( '#^http:#', 'https:', $u ); } );
	}
}, 0 );
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	$m = $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ?? '';
	if ( 'opt' === $m ) {
		header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
		$s = get_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', array() );
		echo wp_json_encode( array( 'file' => $s['apple_pay_verification_file'] ?? null, 'test_mode' => $s['test_mode'] ?? null, 'enable_apple_pay' => $s['enable_apple_pay'] ?? null, 'enable_google_pay' => $s['enable_google_pay'] ?? null ) );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'makefile' === $m ) {
		@mkdir( ABSPATH . '.well-known', 0755, true );
		file_put_contents( ABSPATH . '.well-known/apple-developer-merchantid-domain-association', 'REAL-FILE-ON-DISK' );
		echo 'made';
		exit;
	}
} );
